question: Extend frame A beyond BMF ruling dates: list Schedule D Part I DAF holders whose first e-filed Form 990 (any EIN, any ruling date) is for a 2021+ tax period, and those filing 990-EZ with the DAF question (DonorAdvisedFndsInd) answered yes, to catch new sponsors whose BMF ruling is pre-2021 (reinstatements, group exemptions) or who file 990-EZ (I Maaser filed 990-EZ for TY2022)
rationale: Frame A keys on BMF RULING >= 2021-01 and Schedule D, which is filed only with Form 990; small new sponsors start on 990-EZ/990-N and some carry old ruling dates

question: Resolve status of the four 'unknown' additions (Neta Foundation, DAF Gives Charitable/DAFshare, Monument Charitable, Overflow Foundation) and the parents' founding dates for Givmo, Spiral Financial and Overflow, using robots-allowed company pages, press releases and their TY2025 990s when filed

question: Test the Form 990 Part IV line 6 answer against Schedule D Part I across all filers: count returns that report DAF accounts > 0 in Schedule D Part I while answering 'No' on line 6 (Groundswell's amended TY2024 return: 12,808 accounts, line 6 = 0), and check whether DAFRC or SOI extracts that key on line 6 drop them

rationale: In this frame 14 of 179 DAF-holding EINs (17 of 329 positive returns) never answered yes on line 6, so a line-6 pre-filter loses about 8% of holders; non-dafrc-daf-filers-990.csv starts from the SOI line-6 flag

question: Widen the CF exit screen to community foundations without 'community' in their name that have left the BMF: use DAFRC CF names, Council on Foundations / state CF-association member lists and the IRS index 2019-2020 to build an EIN list, then run the same Schedule N scan
rationale: Frame B finds a CF by name pattern or a current BMF NTEE T31 code; a CF that has terminated is usually gone from the BMF, so an exited CF named, say, 'X Area Fund' or 'Y Foundation' is invisible

question: Trace DAF balances in the four geographic-CF exits that held DAFs on their final Schedule D (Rusk County 6, Fairfield 12, Milbank 4, Coastal 39 accounts): read the successor CF's next 990 Schedule D Part I and any merger notice to see whether the funds were re-established as DAFs, designated or field-of-interest funds
conclusion_affected: Whether CF exits lose DAF character (repo's sponsor-mortality §5 assumes transfer to another sponsor)
rationale: No exiting geographic CF names DAF balances on Schedule N (all describe cash or investments); only the final Schedule D shows DAFs existed, so their destination is inferred, not filed
